title: From the Social Choice Problem to a Collusion-Proof Tendering Mechanism for Dynamic Stochastic Projects
abstract: arXiv:2608.28722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The VCG family and the AGV mechanism are two classical approaches to efficient implementation in the static social choice problem. In 2024, Cs\'oka et al. showed that AGV has critical weaknesses. In contrast, the transferable-utility Guaranteed Utility Mechanism (TU-GUM) retains all the standard desirable properties of AGV while adding further ones, including collusion-proofness, because it implements efficiency in Guaranteed Utility Equilibrium. TU-GUM also applies to a more general dynamic setting with multiple extensions. Moreover, TU-GUM is a special case of an even more general and robust mechanism that combines contingent first-price tendering with the coordinated execution of dynamic stochastic multi-agent projects through a surprisingly simple rule. This paper summarizes and connects existing results from a different perspective, with some minor new observations.

translated_title: 从社会选择问题到动态随机项目的防串通招标机制
translated_abstract: VCG机制族和AGV机制是静态社会选择问题中实现效率的两种经典方法。2024年，Csóka等人证明了AGV机制存在关键性缺陷。相比之下，可转移效用保证效用机制（TU-GUM）不仅保留了AGV机制的所有标准理想性质，还具备更多优良性质，包括防串通性，因为它在保证效用均衡中实现了效率。TU-GUM还适用于具有多重扩展的更一般的动态环境。此外，TU-GUM是一个更一般、更稳健机制的特例，该机制通过一个出奇简单的规则，将条件性一价招标与动态随机多智能体项目的协调执行相结合。本文从不同的视角总结并连接了现有结果，并附带一些次要的新观察。
tldr: 本文提出可转移效用保证效用机制（TU-GUM），它在保留AGV机制全部理想性质的基础上增加了防串通性，并将其作为特例纳入一个通过出奇简单的规则将条件性一价招标与动态随机多智能体项目协调执行相结合的更一般、更稳健的机制框架。
